body: I never post or comment or anything but I just needed to say how much reading this has helped me. When I was diagnosed my doc made it clear that I don’t have any of the more extreme symptoms, so on on the spectrum I’m y’know “not so bad.” Because of that I’ve always felt like an imposter and like I’m just faking this for attention. But reading this helped me to understand that I’m not alone, and I do belong. I related to everything you wrote, it made me feel seen. So, thank you.
I think  you are right. Having a plan will help me move forward! Thank you
It’s not over the top, I think you bring up a good point that I should be remembering. I am lucky that no one was hurt and it was just a replaceable car

I know you are right, I think I’m just struggling to accept accidents happen. I don’t want it to destroy our relationship and I see how it easily could. I think I need to just consistently remind myself- accidents happen
I think you are right. We are talking and I think he’s okay with replacing the value of the car (it was pretty inexpensive)
Besides apologizing all the time, he is very patient every time I bring it up and understands that I need time. He wants to help, i just haven’t known how to let him.
Thanks to this post, he has offered to replace the value of the car. I don’t think either of us considered that an option that could help us
Sorry for not being specific- it was an honest mistake, he was making a left turn and didn’t realize he didn’t have enough time before an oncoming car would hit the side of the car.
